source_title: Solo Leveling's New Main Character Officially Returns In New Release
source_excerpt:
Solo Leveling is an incredibly popular story and is known all over the world, largely down to its main character, Sung Jinwoo. Over the years, Jinwoo has proven to be the heart and soul of the series, with his journey from being the weakest Hunter to a powerful, god-level being taking the world by storm.
With that being said, Jinwoo isn't the only main character in the Solo Leveling universe. In the sequel to the original Solo Leveling, that is, Solo Leveling: Ragnarok , a new main character takes the lead. This new main character is named Sung Suho, and he is Jinwoo's own son. Suho’s story took a break in January 2026, but finally, after a long wait, the Ragnarok manhwa is officially returning with a third season. Suho is taking the spotlight once more from his father, with new, exciting arcs adapting the remainder of the novel by Daul.
Solo Leveling Ragnarok Returns With Sung Suho As Its Main Character
Solo Leveling has cemented itself as the most popular manhwa series globally. Its original novel was already popular, and its manhwa gained a lot of traction, but it's with its anime series, adapted by Aniplex and A-1 Pictures, that it garnered global traction like never before. The overwhelming popularity of the anime after its debut in 2024 has boosted interest in the series, and because of that, fans all over the world are incredibly excited when new information is unveiled concerning the Solo Leveling franchise.
When it comes to the Solo Leveling sequel manhwa, titled Solo Leveling Ragnarok, the series has been on hiatus since January 7, 2026 . This hiatus was kickstarted because of the unavailability of its previous artist, JIN, who had to take a leave due to his mandatory enlistment in the South Korean military. With Jin away, a new artist had been preparing to take over. Finally, after a few months, they are to begin on the franchise. This new return, however, will see Solo Leveling focus on a new main character, and not our beloved Sung Jinwoo. Instead, the sequel puts the spotlight on Sung Jinwoo’s own son, Sung Suho.
For fans who are already familiar with Solo Leveling: Ragnarok, this does not exactly come as a surprise. Sung Suho has always been the main character of the Solo Leveling Ragnarok novel, written between April 10, 2023, and July 23, 2025, by creator Daul. He has also been the main focus of the Manhwa adaptation of the novel, with Solo Leveling: Ragnarok Season 1 being released on August 1, 2024, and the second season following on August 6, 2025. Suho will lead from the front in Solo Leveling: Ragnarok Season 3, as well as any sequel season of Ragnarok that comes after. The new main character, Sung Suho's return was officially announced on October 28, 2026. We also got to see the new Manhwa cover of Ragnarok Season 3, featuring Suho in a new, stylish design, looking eerily similar to his own father in new art by Sanjimseung.
How Suho Replaced Jinwoo and How He Compares
While Solo Leveling as a whole is growing massively in popularity, fans still mostly focus on the TV anime by Aniplex and A-1 Pictures. Even when fans delve into the manhwa, they are often exclusively reading the original story, written by none other than Chugong and illustrated by Dubu from Redice Studio. Solo Leveling Ragnarok, in comparison, is still rather niche and unfamiliar to many fans of the franchise. That's why many fans are surprised to even learn that Jinwoo has a son, and that this son is the main character of his own story.
For those who have read Ragnarok, Sung Suho has been quite a captivating main character. For many of us, he can even be considered a superior version of Sung Jinwoo. All in all, it’s hard to even compare them, as they are quite distinct characters, even though they share some similarities, given that they are father and son. While Jinwoo entirely relies on himself and his own powers, Suho has built himself powerful allies who are always ready to help him in battles.
Sung Suho, just like his father, is a Shadow user, and he acquired these abilities by being Jinwoo's own son . While Suho generally has the same powers as his father, he uses them in an entirely different manner, which makes him stand out quite uniquely without appearing as a copycat of Jinwoo. With his shadow powers, Suho is able to turn Shadows into weapons, and these weapons aren't exclusively used by him, but can also be used by his allies. In a way, he allows his allies to level up. The way he advances through the plot of Ragnarok cements him as a unique protagonist.
In the original Solo Leveling, Jinwoo was the only star, with every other character fading into the background. On the flip side, Suho has been able to elevate his own character, as well as that of his side cast and allies . Clearly, the two are distinct characters that lead unique plots, with only blood and lore connecting them.

Sung Suho’s Story Continues With New Exciting Arcs As We Await More Jinwoo Content
In the original Solo Leveling series, the main antagonists Sung Jinwoo had to face were the Monarchs, a powerful race of beings that have posed difficult challenges for him along the way. Even after the time rewind and the start of the 27 Year Monarch War, these enemies were still Jinwoo's main targets. In Solo Leveling: Ragnarok, however, the story takes a completely new turn. Instead of the Monarchs being the main enemies, this time we are faced with an even bigger threat — the Itarim, or the Outer Gods of the Solo Leveling world . Because of that, Sung Suho faces a challenge even bigger than what his father had to undertake. Not only that, but he has to ally with the powerful new Monarch successors to defeat these foes.
In Solo Leveling: Ragnarok Season 3, we will see the continuation of Sung Suho's journey and his growth in strength until he is able to stand up against his enemies. Sung Jinwoo will also be present in the sequel, but his role is far smaller due to Suho's lead. To see Sung Jinwoo return as the main character, fans will have to be a lot more patient.
The Solo Leveling story following Sung Jinwoo, be it novel or manhwa, has already ended. Unless Chugong decides to return with a new series, we're unlikely to see new content for Sung Jinwoo. What we are expecting, however, is new anime content. We already know that Solo Leveling: Beyond the System is coming in 2027 , and it's set to be the biggest release ever for the franchise, as its first major theatrical movie release. Solo Leveling: Beyond the System is going to be an intense ride, and it will finally put Sung Jinwoo in the spotlight once more.
